name: ionic-design
description: Builds and reviews Ionic Framework UI in Capacitor apps (Ionic 9 current, Ionic 8 still common) - page structure (`ion-header`/`ion-content`/`ion-footer`), lists, modern form syntax (`label`/`labelPlacement` on `ion-input`/`ion-select`), sheet modals, tabs + `ion-router-outlet`, CSS variable theming, dark palettes (`palettes/dark.system.css`, `.ion-palette-dark`), iOS vs MD mode, and Ionic 8 -> 9 breaking changes (React Router 6, Vue Router 5, Angular 18-22 zoneless, removed `ion-picker-legacy`,
author: Cap-go
